record.question: Intensified Diarrhoea Control Fortnight (IDCF) consists of a set of activities include
options: awareness generation activities for diarrhoea management
strengthening service provision for diarrhoea case management
prepositioning of ORS by health worker in households with under-five children
awareness generation activities for hygiene and sanitation.
record.explanation: Intensified Diarrhoea Control Fortnight (IDCF) is a strategy under India's diarrhoea control program that includes multiple components for diarrhoea management. All four options listed are legitimate components of IDCF: awareness generation for diarrhoea management, strengthening service provision for case management, pre-positioning of ORS in households with under-five children, and awareness generation for hygiene and sanitation. The question likely expects one core activity, and awareness generation for diarrhoea management is a fundamental and universal component of IDCF across all implementations.
